text:
nina: Heads-up — vendor-aurora-logistics just messaged: H100 EU ETA slipping 7->13 days due to terminal congestion and depot backlog. This impacts Dedicated EU pools for our mid-month rollout.

vendor-aurora-logistics: confirmed. Options: (A) split ship 18 air (3d) + 22 sea (12-14d) w/ expedite air surcharge $2,800/unit; (B) hold full ocean (13-14d) no surcharge; (C) add temporary spares from upstream pool (10 units) transfer ~9d incl customs. We can include preprinted RMA labels & depot checklist if amendment signed. Depot burn-in fail observed ~0.6%.

maya: please attach ETA spreadsheet, serial manifest, and depot photo acceptance checklist. Need RMA label format spec and expected pickup SLA.

vendor-aurora-logistics: will upload manifest+photos in thread within 2h. RMA label template: {pickup-code}_{depot-id}_{po}. Depot SLA suggested: photos within 24h, burn-in exception flagged via manifest column.

sam: quick math: air surcharge for 18 units = 18*2800 = 50,400. Transfer of 10 from APAC estimate = $9,500 (ship+customs). Delta ≈ $40,900. If launch needs 30 GPUs in EU by D+6 we must decide.

```
air_cost = 18*2800 = 50400
transfer_cost = 9500
delta = 40900
```

liam: EU launch requirement = +30 GPUs by D+6. Current EU slack = 11. If we take air 18, total slack -> 29 (short 1). If we also transfer 10 from APAC (arrive D+9) not helpful. Need at least 20 air to be safe.

ops-eu: we can rehydrate some reserved nodes (4 GPUs) but that still leaves a gap. Transit from us-east is ~8-10d.

nina: priority = launch. @procurement-bot open amendment for split ship w/ spare clause and RMA labels. Flag finance for expedite approval.

procurement-bot: PO 99123_amendment created, includes spare line-items (2/100) and RMA label requirement. Routing to @finance for approval.

vendor-aurora-logistics: note: depots are requesting photo evidence within 24h or they will refuse warranty acceptance. Strongly recommend SLA in amendment. Also recommend adding 1% spare buffer due to burn-in.

maya: agree on SLA: depot photos <=24h, serial CSV with columns: serial, sku, shipped_ts, depot_id, photo_sha256, burnin_status. Add clause for RMA pickup within 72h for failed units.

sam: propose approving 20 air units (20*2800 = 56k) + spares per vendor offer. Finance sign-off needed.

finance: approve one-time expedite spend under code 4201 up to $60k. Please attach updated invoice and cost allocation.

procurement-bot: amendment updated with finance approval tag. Vendor to confirm pick/pack and send airwaybill + manifest.

vendor-aurora-logistics: confirmed. Air AWB: AU123EU (ETA 72h). Ocean BL: AU999SEA (ETA 13d). Included 2 spare units per 100 and preprinted RMA labels. Manifest uploaded: manifest_eu_1799999998.csv (attached). Depot photo checklist uploaded.

ops-eu: prepping depot teams for 24h photo SLA and RMA pickup staging. Will add depot contact roster to manifest comment.

liam: thanks. Capture RMA burn-in rate in ops dashboard — create alert if burn-in >0.6% for this wave. We need to know if spares policy was cost-effective.

nina: vendor, please include proof-of-inspection photos and confirm crate-level RMA label placement. Procurement, close loop on PO once invoice lands.

vendor-aurora-logistics: will send final invoice + crate photos within 2 hours. Tagging: @nina @maya.

procurement-bot: PO 99123_amendment -> vendor confirmed -> invoice routing to finance. Thread will be archived for 60d for post-mortem metrics.

sam: capture final numbers in cost tracker and mark this as a precedent for spare-inclusion if depot burn-in <1% over Q.

maya: noted. I’ll monitor manifest ingestion and RMA label scanning on arrival.

nina: closing — thanks team. Follow-up: ops please post RMA burn-in metrics to this thread within 7 days of arrival so procurement can evaluate spare policy.
